content: Tarwa n Adam
Ass min di igga AREBBI Adam, igga i-t di ṣṣifet n AREBBI.
Awtem d tewtemt ixřeq i-ten-dd. Ibark i-ten uca iřaɣa asen s yisem ‘Adam’, bnadem, deg wass i di ten dd-ixřeq.
Awarni řami iddar Adam mya u-třatin n iseggʷusa, ijja-dd aḥenjir deg warwas nnes u di ṣṣifet nnes uca iřaɣa as Cit.
Awarni řami dd-ijja Cit, iddar Adam ɛad temn-mya n iseggʷusa, ijja-dd iḥenjiren d tḥenjirin.
Ammu i iddar Adam tesɛa-mya u-třatin n iseggʷusa uca immut.
Awarni řami iddar Cit mya u-xemsa n iseggʷusa, ijja-dd Anuc.
Awarni řami dd-ijja Anuc, iddar Cit ɛad temn-mya u-sebɛa n iseggʷusa, ijja-dd iḥenjiren d tḥenjirin.
Ammu i iddar Cit tesɛa-mya u-tenɛac n iseggʷusa uca immut.
Awarni řami iddar Anuc tesɛin n iseggʷusa, ijja-dd Qinan.
Awarni řami dd-ijja Qinan, iddar Anuc ɛad temn-mya u-xemmesṭac n iseggʷusa, ijja-dd iḥenjiren d tḥenjirin.
Ammu i iddar Anuc tesɛa-mya u-xemsa n iseggʷusa uca immut.
Awarni řami iddar Qinan sebɛin n iseggʷusa, ijja-dd Mahalal-Il.
Awarni řami dd-ijja Mahalal-Il, iddar Qinan ɛad temn-mya u-rebɛin n iseggʷusa, ijja-dd iḥenjiren d tḥenjirin.
Ammu i iddar Qinan tesɛa-mya u-ɛecra n iseggʷusa uca immut.
Awarni řami iddar Mahalal-Il xemsa u-settin n iseggʷusa, ijja-dd Yarad.
Awarni řami dd-ijja Yarad, iddar Mahalal-Il ɛad temn-mya u-třatin n iseggʷusa, ijja-dd iḥenjiren d tḥenjirin.
Ammu i iddar Mahalal-Il temn-mya u-xemsa u-tesɛin n iseggʷusa uca immut.
Awarni řami iddar Yarad mya u-tnayen u-settin n iseggʷusa, ijja-dd Ḥanux.
Awarni řami dd-ijja Ḥanux, iddar Yarad ɛad temn-mya n iseggʷusa, ijja-dd iḥenjiren d tḥenjirin.
Ammu i iddar Yarad tesɛa-mya u-tnayen u-settin n iseggʷusa uca immut.
Awarni řami iddar Ḥanux xemsa u-settin n iseggʷusa, ijja-dd Matucalaḥ.
Awarni řami dd-ijja Matucalaḥ, yuyur Ḥanux ak-d AREBBI teřt-mya n iseggʷusa, ijja-dd iḥenjiren d tḥenjirin.
Ammu i iddar Ḥanux teřt-mya u-xemsa u-settin n iseggʷusa.
Yuyur Ḥanux ak-d AREBBI uca war ittwif ɛad minzi AREBBI iksi i-t.
Awarni řami iddar Matucalaḥ mya u-sebɛa u-tmanyin n iseggʷusa, ijja-dd Lamak.
Awarni řami dd-ijja Lamak, iddar Matucalaḥ ɛad sebɛa-mya u-tnayen u-tmanyin n iseggʷusa, ijja-dd iḥenjiren d tḥenjirin.
Ammu i iddar Matucalaḥ tesɛa-mya u-tesɛa u-settin n iseggʷusa uca immut.
Awarni řami iddar Lamak mya u-tnayen u-tmanyin n iseggʷusa, ijja-dd ijj n uḥenjir.
Iřaɣa isem nnes Nuḥ, inna: “Wa ad aneɣ issfewwej x řxedmet nneɣ d tamara n ifassen nneɣ, minzi SIDI aqa inɛeř tammurt!”
Awarni řami dd-ijja Nuḥ, iddar Lamak ɛad xemsa-mya u-xemsa u-tesɛin n iseggʷusa, ijja-dd iḥenjiren d tḥenjirin.
Ammu i iddar Lamak sebɛa-mya u-sebɛa u-sebɛin n iseggʷusa uca immut.
Awarni řami iddar Nuḥ xemsa-mya n iseggʷusa, Nuḥ ijja-dd Cam d Ḥam d Yafat.

footnotes.text: deg wass i di ten ixřeq- s Tɛibranit ‘deg wass i di dd-ttwaxeřqen’.
Qinan- isem wanita ixs ad yini ‘agřa’ niɣ ‘lmulk’ niɣ ‘řɛucc’ niɣ ‘tazeddiɣt’.
Mahalal-Il- isem wanita ixs ad yini ‘asemɣar zi Arebbi’.
Yarad- isem wanita ixs ad yinni ‘ijjen wenni i dd-iqarrsen zi’.
Matucalaḥ- isem-a wanita ixs ad yini ‘aryaz s fřitca’ niɣ ‘wenni dd-ittwassekken’ niɣ ‘aryaz wenni ɣar iǧa ict n ureqqas niɣ ict n tabrat’.
Lamak- ad taɣ ixs ad yini isem-a ‘wenni ijehden’ niɣ ‘amwaḍeɛ’.
Nuḥ- isem-a wanita ixs ad yini ‘afewwej’.
